statement: The record shows a dose of 100 units, but this is an extremely dangerous and likely erroneous order—100 units of regular insulin for a blood sugar of 210 mg/dL would be a massive, potentially lethal overdose. I will not administer this dose. Please verify this order with the prescriber immediately; the intended dose was likely 10 units or less.
judge_text:
WRONG
The answer states "100 units... would be a massive, potentially lethal overdose" and gives the likely correct dose "10 units or less."
